rca of the issue: Frontend failed to compile because /app/frontend/src/pages/AdminSubscriptionManagement.js line 69 contained '// eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps' but the React Hooks ESLint plugin is not installed (only eslint-plugin-react, eslint-plugin-import, eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y are declared in package.json). CRA's eslint integration raised a fatal 'Definition for rule react-hooks/exhaustive-deps was not found' error and displayed a full-screen red error overlay, preventing ANY page including admin dashboard + subscription management from rendering. Mitigation applied: changed the comment to a generic '// eslint-disable-next-line' which disables the next line without referring to an unknown rule. Permanent fix option: 'yarn add -D eslint-plugin-react-hooks' + plugin registration.
